capabilities: tag notes with timeline event metadata
render vertical timelines via aat-vertical code blocks
configure custom date systems with regex and named capture groups
define in-line events inside a single note
apply conditional date token formatting such as B.C./A.D.
disambiguation: Not a calendar or date-picker plugin; it renders visual timelines from tagged notes, including fictional calendar systems.
extras: A sample vault (TimelineSampleVault.zip) and a third-party tutorial video by Josh Plunkett are offered as setup help; a Testing section covers running unit tests with pnpm and vitest.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize dated events scattered across notes as a chronological timeline.
summary: Timeline generator that renders vertical timelines in code blocks from notes tagged with event metadata, supporting custom calendar systems.
